purchases.closeShortMessage: The remaining {{value}} will be cancelled. Money already paid stays as advance with the company.
purchases.confirmHint: Once confirmed, goods can be received against this order.

purchases.title: Purchases
purchases.undeliveredHint: Value paid for but not yet delivered.

aging.subtitle: What customers owe, by how long ago the invoice was raised.
aging.title: Customer aging

sales.chooseAccount: Choose the account the money went into.
sales.chooseProduct: Choose a product for each line.
sales.companyDiscountHint: Reimbursed by the company; it does not reduce our sales.
sales.deleteDraftMessage: Delete this draft? It has not been posted, so nothing else changes.
sales.enterAmount: Enter an amount greater than zero.
sales.enterQty: Enter a quantity for each line.
sales.formHint: Pick the customer and items. Stock leaves in first-expiry-first-out order when the invoice is posted.
sales.freeCompany: Free goods paid for by the company
sales.itemsHint: One line per product. Prices default to the trade price.
sales.onlyDraftsEdit: Only drafts can be edited. This invoice has been posted.
sales.paidHint: Cash taken at the counter now. The rest is due from the customer.

sales.printFailed: The invoice could not be printed.
sales.receiptHint: Record money received from a customer.

claims.settlementHint: The company still owes {{value}} on this claim.
claims.submitHint: Once submitted, the items are locked into this claim and it gets a number.
claims.subtitle: What the companies owe us for discounts, free goods, commissions and returned goods.
claims.supplierCreditNote: The amount is credited to your account with the company, as an advance against future purchases.
claims.title: Company claims

returns.cashHint: Money is paid back to the customer from an account.
returns.chooseBatch: Choose the batch for each tracked product.
returns.creditHint: The amount reduces what the customer owes.
returns.enterQty: Enter a quantity to return on at least one row.
returns.enterValue: Enter the agreed value per unit.
returns.purchaseHint: Send goods back to the company. Agree the credit per unit and how it is settled.
returns.purchaseItemsHint: Choose where the goods are now (damaged goods sit in the damaged location).

returns.unitValueHint: What the company credits. Defaults to the dealer price.

stockDocs.title: Adjustments and transfers
stockDocs.transferHint: Move stock between locations, for example sellable to expired. The cost moves with it.
stockDocs.writeOffNote: Booked as a write-off, not as a stock difference.

finance.title: Finance
finance.subtitle: Expenses, money moved between accounts, and owner capital or drawings.

expense.title: Record an expense
expense.hint: Money paid out to run the business. It is booked to the expense account and taken from the account you pick.

transfer.title: Move money between accounts
transfer.hint: Moves money from one account to another. Charges are booked as bank and MFS charges.

owner.title: Owner capital or drawings
owner.hint: Capital is money the owner puts into the business; drawings are money the owner takes out. Neither is income or an expense.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Profit, cash, stock and receivables. Every figure comes from the books, not from typed-in totals.
reports.noAccess: Your role has no reports. Ask the owner for access.
reports.plNote: Net profit = gross profit + scheme and other income − write-offs − dealer commission − operating expenses. Owner money and transfers are not income or expense.
